name: record_vendor_invoice
purpose: Record a supplier's invoice as a payable in Accounts Payable.
rules: Take the amount and due date from the invoice itself; never type them from memory.
If the invoice states two different amounts, do not choose between them; ask a person.
Payables above the auto-approval limit need sign-off before they are recorded.
If the invoice is already on file, confirm the existing record instead of entering it again.
